## Elanco to Participate in BofA Securities Global Healthcare Conference 2026


September 17, 2026


[PDF Version](https://investor.elanco.com/node/14876/pdf)


INDIANAPOLIS


, Sept. 17, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Elanco Animal Health Incorporated (NYSE: ELAN) will attend the BofA Securities Global Healthcare Conference 2026 on September 22, 2026. Jeff Simmons, president and CEO, will participate in a fireside chat on Tuesday, September 22 at 2:10 p.m. BST (9:10 a.m. EDT).


A live audio webcast will be available in the "Events and Presentations" section of Elanco's investor[website](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4776249-1&h=689730426&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.elanco.com%2Fnews-events%2Fevents-presentation&a=website) . A replay will be available for a limited time at the conclusion of the event.


**ABOUT ELANCO**
Elanco Animal Health Incorporated (NYSE: ELAN) is a global leader in animal health dedicated to innovating and delivering products and services to prevent and treat disease in farm animals and pets, creating value for farmers, pet owners, veterinarians, stakeholders and society as a whole. With more than 70 years of animal health heritage, we are committed to breaking boundaries and going beyond to help our customers improve the health of animals in their care, while also making a meaningful impact on our local and global communities. At Elanco, we are driven by our vision of Food and Companionship Enriching Life and our purpose – all to Go Beyond for Animals, Customers, Society and Our People. Learn more at[www.elanco.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4776249-1&h=2182772086&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.elanco.com%2F&a=www.elanco.com) .
